children: Austin, Texas, United States, September 9th, 2026, FinanceWire

an innovative technology company transforming the housing market with its modular building systems, highlighted a portfolio of completed and in-progress projects demonstrating deployments of its factory-built housing system nationwide. Projects include a permanent 12-unit park-model RV Casita installation at American Campground in Las Vegas, wildfire relief support in Pasadena, California, a 12-unit stacked Casita project for Catholic Charities in Oklahoma City and the 12-unit Pasadera short-term rental community near Oklahoma State University.

BOXABL is also working with Horizons Getaways on a network of eco-luxury cabin resorts across multiple states, with 10 units already delivered to locations in South Carolina and Texas and additional sites planned in Tennessee, Florida, California and Ohio. The company has secured approvals for the Casita Studio in Arizona, California, New Mexico, Nevada, South Carolina and Texas and continues developing additional housing configurations, including its prototype Baby Box and stackable and connectable models designed for townhomes, multifamily developments and larger single-family homes.
To view the full press release, visit https://ibn.fm/0GM81

Since its inception in 2017, BOXABL has raised over $230 million from more than 50,000 investors. The North Las Vegas-based company is dedicated to transforming the housing industry through innovative technology and design, with a mission of making housing affordable at mass-production scale. BOXABL’s flagship product, the Casita, is a 361-square-foot studio unit with a full kitchen, bathroom and utilities that unfolds on-site in under an hour. The Company also offers the smaller 120-square-foot Baby Box and is developing stackable and connectable modules designed to form townhomes, multifamily units, and larger single-family homes. BOXABL began trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker symbol “BXBL” on July 20, 2026, following the completion of its business combination with FG Merger II Corp.
